Uses TRADES (not ORDERS) for executed volume; identifies top broker by total sell notional using SELLER_BROKER_ID; computes notional as PRICE * VOLUME; filters current calendar year via EXTRACT(YEAR...); never uses SIDE on TRADES table.
Use ORDERS + SIDE='B' for buy intent. Use LEFT JOIN + NVL to handle missing years. Never use TRADES for side-specific volume. Never INNER JOIN max(year1) with min(year2).

Use ORDERS + SIDE='B' for buy volume. Define decades as 2010-2019 vs 2020-2029. Use LEFT JOIN + NVL. Rank by (current - prev) DESC. NEVER use MAX(current) AND MIN(prev) — impossible. Never use TRADES or DAILY_INDICATORS for side-specific volume.
Aggregates VALUE from TRADES table; joins with SYMBOLS for symbol name; filters last 700 days from today; limits to top 10 by traded value.

Covers full years 2015–2025; aggregates repo volume by exchange and leg; separately calculates total yearly volume per client (counting both sides); identifies top client each year; joins client name via EDS_CLIENTS.

Computes executed buy and sell notional per client from ATS.TRADES using a UNION ALL role-normalisation pattern and avoids OR joins. Filters ENTRY_DATETIME to the current calendar year and returns the top 10 clients by buy/sell notional ratio.

Computes, for each symbol, the OPEN_PRICE on the first trading day of 2022 and the CLOSE_PRICE on the last trading day of 2022, then ranks by the absolute difference. Uses ROW_NUMBER windows over STATS_DATE within ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS and joins to ATS.SYMBOLS for the symbol label.

Uses correct relative spread: average of (spread/mid) per quote, not (avg spread)/(avg mid). Protects against division-by-zero with NULLIF and filters out zero/negative mids. Added basic sanity filters and optional minimum quote count for reliability.
Detects round-trip patterns (A→B and B→A on same symbol). Each unique (broker, counterparty, symbol) pair with both directions counts once. Classic wash-trade / circular trading surveillance query.
Uses ORDERS.STATE → ORDER_STATES.STATE_CODE = 'Cancel' as the canonical way to identify cancelled orders. Market breakdown via MARKETS.MARKET_CODE (not EXCHANGES).
Purged orders are identified via ORDER_STATES.STATE_CODE = 'Purged' — NOT via REJECTED_ORDERS or text search on rejection description. This is the correct semantic source.

Static lookup table showing every possible order lifecycle state (New, Partial, Filled, Cancel, Purged, Rejected, Expired, etc.). Always use this table for state-based questions — never guess or use REJECTED_ORDERS for non-rejection states.

'Market-wise' or 'by market' in this environment means logical trading segment via ATS.MARKETS.MARKET_CODE (e.g., MAINBOARD, DEBT, ETF). NEVER use EXCHANGES.EXCHANGE_NAME unless the user explicitly says 'exchange-wise' or mentions DSE/CSE/etc.

Ranks symbols by total TURNOVER_VALUE over last 30 days (standard volume proxy). Then pulls the SINGLE most recent day's OHLC (not average, not max/min). This is the industry-standard and only correct way to answer 'OHLC of top N symbols by volume'.

Pulls full details per order event: placement (ENTRY_DATETIME), state changes (STATE_TIME, STATE_CODE), parties (client/broker), venue (symbol/exchange/market), sizes (volume/price/notional). Order by ORDER_NO and STATE_CHANGE_TIME to trace lifecycle per order. Limit to 200 for performance.

Shows full repo cycle per CONTRACT_NO: leg 1 (initial) to leg 2 (repurchase), with all details (parties, rates, prices, yields, profits, settlements). Orders by CONTRACT_NO then LEG for easy tracing. Uses LEFT JOINs for optional fields; filters to January of current year (2025).
Executed = existence of a trade in ATS.TRADES. Compares TRUNC(ORDERS.ENTRY_DATETIME) vs TRUNC(TRADES.ENTRY_DATETIME) on the same EXCHANGE_ID and filters to the last 30 days.

Uses IS_SHORT = '1' for genuine short-selling trades (borrow required) and '0' for normal long trades. COALESCE ensures symbols with only one type appear with zeros. Fixed calendar-year filter (2025). Never confuse with SIDE column – 'S' just means sell-side, not short.

Canonical pattern for 'complete client trading report'. Always resolve client name → CLIENT_ID first. Trades & repos require checking both BUYER_CLIENT_ID and SELLER_CLIENT_ID (IN clause or OR). Use fixed calendar year boundaries. Output as key-value rows for easy reading.

Canonical broker report pattern. Lookup via SUBSCRIBED_BROKERS.BROKER_NAME → BROKER_ID. Trades & repo use BUYER_BROKER_ID / SELLER_BROKER_ID (both sides). Only first CTE has column list → avoids ORA-32039/32040.

Canonical symbol report pattern. Uses year_bounds CTE for clean date handling. Only first CTE has column list (safe WITH syntax). All domains aggregated and LEFT JOINed for single-row beautiful output. Never returns SYMBOL_ID in final SELECT.
Price growth = (max close - min open)/min open *100. Filters per-row non-zero/null prices in WHERE; aggregate checks in HAVING. For negative growth, change WHERE >10 to < -10 and ORDER ASC.
